Account Payable Officer Job at Resource Intermediaries Limited




        
    

        
        Resource Intermediaries Limited is a professional Managementfirm into all core Human Resource Services such as training, recruiting, manpower outsourcing, payroll management, business process outsourcing and general HR consulting services with over 18 years of industrial experience. We pride ourselves in easing business burdens.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account Payable Officer

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Institution: Financial Institution

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Review and processes all transactions for payments for services or goods procured on behalf of Stanbic IBTC group in accordance with the group’s policies and guidelines.
	Process all local payments, ensuring vendors are paid timeously, correct amounts are paid and accounts are accurately allocated with proper authority obtained.
	Process all foreign payments (through IBC) for items, ensuring vendors are paid timeously, correct amounts are paid and accounts are accurately allocated and proper authority obtained.
	Process all staff claims ensuring the claims are paid timeously, correct amounts are paid and accounts are accurately allocated and proper authority obtained.
	Review prior day transactions of other team members, adequate call over of transactions.
	Review and reconcile the prepayment accounts while ensuring accurate amortization and that there are no un-amortised amounts.
	Prepare (where applicable) and capture accruals for unpaid invoices as advised by business units and ensure adequate provisions and month end allocations are made as applicable before close of each month.
	Ensure smooth run of month end activities, support Business units, manage/monitor team in all month-end processes to ensure deadlines are met and there are no disruptions to day to day and month end activities.


Requirements


	BSc Degree (Without Third Class or Pass) in Finance and Accounting.
	Maximum age: 27 years.
	ICAN (Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria); ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) or MBA is an added advantage.
	1-2 years of experience in Accounting field
	Computer literate
	Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office
	Knowledge of Accounting Software package
	Must be willing to work in Victoria Island.


Benefits


	Salary: N180,000 monthly.
	13th-month salary
	HMO
	Paid leave allowance
	Pension.

Store Inventory Officer Job at Egbin Power Plc




        
    

        
        Egbin Power Plc. Lagos is one of the biggest additions to the electricity industry in Nigeria. Often seen as the biggest single generating power station in Sub-Saharan Africa, it was built to meet the every rising demand for electricity in Lagos and its environs.

Following the nation’s privatization exercise, Sahara, through its power division, Sahara Power Group and sundry affiliations, acquired the 1320 MW installed capacity Egbin Power Plant. We are working towards deploying a minimum of 5,000 MW of electricity generation over the next five years.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Store Inventory Officer
     

            
    



Job Identification: 226
Job Location: Ikorodu, Lagos
Employment type: Full-time
Job Category: Non-Technical

Job Summary


	A Store Inventory Officer who will be responsible for all operations related to inventory management.


Key Duties and Responsibilities


	To maintain records of receipts as well as issuance of items going out of the warehouse to ensure accuracy and completeness.
	Responsible for handling the stores' data centre and building of inventory material database (Warehouse material list).
	To supervise the offloading process and subsequent arrangement of materials and consignment to ensure safe custody for easy access and identification  
	Reconciliation of physical stock with stock in the system.
	To undertake the function of stock taking and confirm the periodic stock regularly by working closely with the designated staff. 
	Monitor inventory levels to ascertain reorder levels.
	Ensure compliance with all safety procedures required in the warehouse.
	Provide administrative assistance to the department as required.
	Generate the required weekly, monthly, quarterly, bi-annually and annual reports.


Requirements
Education and Work Experience:


	Minimum of BSC or HND qualification in Engineering, Supply Chain Management or numeric disciplines.
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role.
	Knowledge of automated store inventory management.


Skills and Competencies:


	Good analytical and organizational skills.
	Knowledge of Inventory management.
	Proficient with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
	Ability to take initiative.
	Good oral and written communication skills.
	Interpersonal Relationship skills.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Blockchain Engineer

Job Location: Fully Remote | Worldwide
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for experienced Blockchain Engineers to join our team as we build a next-generation cryptocurrency trading platform.
	The platform is evolving from an existing P2P trading system into a centralized exchange (CEX) architecture, with a focus on building secure, scalable, high-performance trading and blockchain infrastructure.


Responsibilities
You will contribute to both the development and technical direction of the platform, working across areas including:


	Cryptocurrency trading and exchange infrastructure
	Order management and matching systems
	Real-time market data services
	Wallet and blockchain integrations
	Blockchain transactions and on-chain infrastructure
	Scalable backend systems and APIs
	System security, performance, and reliability
	Technical architecture and engineering decisions


Requirements


	Minimum 3 years of professional software engineering experience
	Strong experience with blockchain and cryptocurrency technologies
	Hands-on experience building or integrating blockchain-based applications, wallets, exchanges, or financial systems
	Strong backend development and API design experience
	Good understanding of blockchain architecture, transactions, wallets, and smart contracts
	Experience with databases, distributed systems, and scalable infrastructure
	Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
	Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
	Strong communication and collaboration skills
	A technical portfolio or GitHub demonstrating relevant engineering work


Nice to Have:


	Experience building crypto exchanges, trading platforms, or P2P systems
	Experience with order books and matching engines
	Experience with real-time market data systems
	Experience integrating multiple blockchain networks
	Experience with smart contracts and Web3 infrastructure
	Experience working with high-volume or financial technology platforms
	Experience contributing to technical architecture and engineering strategy.


What we offer


	Salary: N2,000,000 - N6,000,000 monthly.
	Fully remote work from anywhere in the world
	Competitive salary paid in USD
	Opportunity to work on a next-generation crypto trading platform
	Opportunity to contribute to architecture and technical direction
	International and collaborative working environment

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Roles &amp; Duties
Office Operations &amp; Coordination:


	Assist in overseeing the day-to-day operations of the office to ensure smooth and efficient functioning.
	Monitor the general activities within the office and ensure staff comply with established administrative procedures.
	Support the Head of Administration in coordinating inter-departmental administrative activities.
	Identify operational issues and escalate them promptly to the Head of Administration.


Office Property &amp; Facility Management:


	Take responsibility for the proper use, care and maintenance of office properties and facilities.
	Monitor the condition of office spaces, furniture, fittings and other company properties to prevent damage, misuse or unnecessary wear and tear.
	Ensure that office facilities are kept clean, functional, organised and presentable at all times.
	Report damages, faults or maintenance requirements promptly and follow up until they are resolved.


Company Vehicles &amp; Transportation:


	Oversee the proper use and general condition of company vehicles.
	Maintain records of company vehicles, assigned drivers, servicing, repairs, fuel usage and other related expenses.
	Ensure vehicles are used strictly for authorised official purposes.
	Monitor vehicle maintenance schedules and ensure servicing and repairs are carried out when due.
	Report any misuse, damage, accident or mechanical issue involving company vehicles.


Office Equipment &amp; Assets:


	Be responsible for monitoring office equipment, including computers, printers, air conditioners, office appliances, generators and other operational equipment.
	Maintain an up-to-date inventory of office assets and equipment.
	Ensure equipment is properly handled, used responsibly and maintained regularly.
	Monitor the movement of company equipment and ensure items are not removed from the office without proper authorisation.
	Report missing, damaged or malfunctioning equipment immediately.


Inventory &amp; Office Supplies:


	Monitor office supplies and consumables to ensure adequate stock is maintained.
	Keep proper records of items purchased, issued and remaining in stock.
	Liaise with approved vendors for the procurement of routine office supplies when required.
	Prevent wastage and ensure company resources are used responsibly.


Maintenance &amp; Repairs:


	Coordinate routine maintenance and repairs of office facilities, equipment and company properties.
	Liaise with technicians, artisans, service providers and vendors when necessary.
	Follow up on outstanding repairs and ensure issues are resolved promptly and satisfactorily.


Security &amp; Proper Use of Company Property:


	Assist in ensuring the security and proper handling of company assets and properties.
	Monitor compliance with office rules regarding the use of company facilities, equipment and vehicles.
	Immediately report suspected misuse, negligence, loss or damage of company property.


Administrative Support:


	Support the Head of Administration in implementing administrative policies and procedures.
	Assist in preparing administrative reports, records and documentation.
	Support the coordination of meetings, office activities and other administrative assignments.
	Perform other administrative responsibilities assigned by the Head of Administration or Management.


Requirements


	Must be a Male and has a Driver`s License.


Salary
N100,000 - N150,000 monthly.
